VcXsrv Windows X Server
=======================

The Windows distribution includes a portable, independently developed
third-party X server. Its executables and dependencies are stored outside
app.asar under resources/third-party/vcxsrv-runtime.

  File: vcxsrv-64.1.20.14.0.installer.exe
  Version: 1.20.14.0 (64-bit)
  SHA-256: 7A5CD7D9D0AC982F09C8A93051FC48AB072FCC4B52237D1B91494363B9DAD27E
  Project: https://github.com/marchaesen/vcxsrv
  Legacy download page: https://sourceforge.net/projects/vcxsrv/
  License: GNU General Public License, version 3 (GPL-3.0)

LiteConnect starts this component on demand for automatic SSH X11 forwarding.
No system-wide installation, registry setup or administrator rights are needed.
The server is authenticated with MIT-MAGIC-COOKIE-1; each SSH connection uses
a separate replacement cookie. User-managed X servers are never terminated.
The application terminates only its own display processes on graceful exit.

See VcXsrv-GPL-3.0.txt for the GNU GPL version 3 text. Upstream font/bitmap
notices are preserved in the portable runtime. Corresponding source and build
instructions are available from the project and legacy download page above.

Exact corresponding source (upstream tag 1.20.14.0):
  https://github.com/marchaesen/vcxsrv/tree/1.20.14.0
  https://github.com/marchaesen/vcxsrv/archive/refs/tags/1.20.14.0.tar.gz
  Commit: 8cc20250c9d0a2a590e78dd5e27429e06b4588f7
